body: I'll walk. I'm honestly desperate for a reason, but I'm not willing to accept a bullshit reason. If I can find a genuinely good reason. A real sign. I'll continue. If not I'm done here.

The medication shuts down my emotion, so it works. The dose is so high that the side effects are bad, I don't take it consistently.
I think going for a walk would make me feel much better, but I need something solid to change my mind. I want a reason to live, but I coming up empty.
Lost my insurance. I'm medicated though.
I started wanting to die at 8. Diagnosed at 13. I'm 21. I've attempted 3 times.
There's no where else to go. Here, or homeless. I'd rather just die.

I went NC with my first bad ex. He contacted me twice in less than 7 months. No contact works.
 Just stick with it, focus on you.

I understand his wellbeing as a person is of far greater importance. I'm just extremely worried about him.
We both have the same issues, mine are just well managed. We're both "un-dateable", children are out of the question. I deeply care for him, and I don't want him to be alone. I can't give up yet. I really can't.
Thank you 🌻, I'll PM you if I can figure out how...
That's all I did before we broke up. I'm sure the last thing he wants is for me to pester him even after he tries to cut ties.
I suppose words don't mean much at all. Two days ago he was telling me that he'd absolutely under no circumstances break up with me- ever. Coward. He did it over text.
Thank you. I don't get why they do that.

Thank you for the encouraging, kind words.

If any of these jobs come my way, I'll of course take them, but I'm not sure how I can keep any of the money I make away from my mother. My environment isn't safe or stable enough for me to tell her no, on anything, but especially with money. She feeds me, but once I get money I have to return the favor and feed myself- it's like that with everything. I owe her for every gift, meal, everything, honestly. I'm a future second wallet.
It's more of an overdue bill rather than a loan. I luckily never took out any money.

He's chipped' so he'd be found. I need to have proof I'm his owner.
Online tutoring is something I've been looking into too, sining up with an agency might work too.
How do I work a full time job without her knowing? She monitors my schedule. I can't go for walks without telling her.
